# 300. Asset Direct Ingestion & Linked A/V Split Engine

**Date:** 2026-10-22  
**Scope:** `apps/studio`, `packages/ir`, `schema/modifiers.schema.json`, `autogenerated-tests/`  
**Pillar:** Master Integration Plan Iteration 23 - Pillar 3  

---

## 🎯 Executive Summary
Pillar 3 implements direct drag-and-drop ingestion from the `LeftSidebar` (Staging Presets & Asset Vault) into `Timeline.tsx` track lanes, combined with an atomic **Linked A/V Split Engine**. Ingesting a video asset possessing audio automatically provisions synchronized sequences across discrete video (`track-v1`) and audio (`track-a1`) tracks linked mutually via the schema-compliant `editorial/av_link` modifier (`{ linkedSequenceId, linkedTrackId, enabled: true, syncTrim: true }`). Moving or trimming either sequence performs symmetrical transformation on its partner sequence unless explicitly unlinked.

---

## 🏗️ Architectural Changes & Implementations

### 1. Schema Sync & Runtime Validation
- **`packages/ir/src/types/modifiers.ts`**:
  - Registered `AVLinkModifierParams` interface:
    ```typescript
    export interface AVLinkModifierParams {
      linkedSequenceId: string;
      linkedTrackId: string;
      enabled?: boolean;
      syncTrim?: boolean;
    }
    ```
  - Added `'editorial/av_link'` to `ModifierType` and `ModifierNode`.
- **`schema/modifiers.schema.json`**:
  - Registered `AVLinkModifierParams` definition with required fields (`linkedSequenceId`, `linkedTrackId`) and optional boolean properties (`enabled`, `syncTrim`).
  - Added reference in `ModifierNode` schema definition.
- **`packages/ir/src/schema/VideoIRSchemaValidator.ts`**:
  - Implemented parameter validation case for `'editorial/av_link'`.

### 2. Prober Audio Detection
- **`packages/ir/src/prober/AssetMetadataProber.ts`**:
  - Extended probe metadata to include `hasAudio?: boolean`.
- **`apps/studio/src/lib/ir/BrowserAssetMetadataProber.ts`**:
  - Added audio stream detection on video elements and audio buffers.

### 3. Atomic Timeline Commands
- **`apps/studio/src/lib/commands/AddLinkedAVSequenceCommand.ts`**:
  - Atomically adds linked video and audio sequences. Auto-provisions missing tracks when necessary and completely cleans up on undo.
- **`apps/studio/src/lib/commands/MoveSequenceCommand.ts`**:
  - Detects active `editorial/av_link` modifiers on target sequence.
  - Symmetrically translates partner sequence start frame by identical `deltaShift`.
  - Reversible via undo/redo command stack.
- **`apps/studio/src/lib/commands/TrimSequenceCommand.ts` & `RippleTrimSequenceCommand.ts`**:
  - When `syncTrim !== false` and `enabled !== false`, trimming head or tail symmetrically trims the linked partner sequence.
- **`apps/studio/src/lib/ir/irState.ts`**:
  - Added convenience method `addLinkedAVSequences(...)`.

### 4. Interactive UI & Timeline Ingestion
- **`apps/studio/src/App.tsx`**:
  - Enhanced root `handleDragEnd` to detect drops over track lanes (`over.id.startsWith('track-')`).
  - Implemented drop frame calculation relative to track lane offset with magnetic playhead snapping (within 4 frames).
  - Video assets with audio streams trigger `addLinkedAVSequences`, cleanly splitting video to target track and audio to `track-a1`.
- **`apps/studio/src/components/Timeline.tsx`**:
  - Added `Link2` / `Unlink` interactive button inside `TimelineClipItem` allowing instant clip-level toggling of linked movement and trim.
- **`apps/studio/src/components/inspector/SequenceInspector.tsx`**:
  - Added "Linked Audio / Video" inspector card displaying partner sequence ID, track badge, and interactive link/unlink toggle.
